overview_description.description: Rimba is an AI-powered platform that automates compliance and audit processes for industrial operations. The company focuses on manufacturing, oil and gas, and chemical companies. Its solutions streamline EPA compliance, carbon reporting, and tax credit documentation by transforming operational data into accurate compliance reports, thereby reducing manual work and errors.
